analysis.first_analysis_result: Stopped at the nested raw-byte hash gate before producing a timing summary
analysis.demonstrated_cause: The native Windows serializer wrote CRLF, while the analyzer initially reconstructed LF bytes.
analysis.correction: Accept only the exact canonical serializer in LF or CRLF form. Preserve declared raw SHA256 and values. Reject arbitrary formatting and invalid receipts.

scope: Three fixed initial states, two forest sizes and one seed on one shared Windows workstation. Six controller-block means per comparison. No rebuild or cross-machine repetition. Individual approximate intervals, not simultaneous confidence across all 24 comparisons.
